versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Salamanders who put the same few units into the fire again and again: each Reforge gives +1/+1, a lasting Heat counter and a burn that lasts one fight.
Cards turn Heat into keywords, extra lives that shrink each time, Attack in the fight or a one-off cash-out, paid for with unspent gold, sold units and spare slots.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording fixes only: Bellows-Boy always spends what gold it can, Two-Tongs copies don't stack, and Wet Cellar Keeper always heals after other End of Turn effects.
The Furnace got a worked example, and the Ember-Belly plus Ottilie self-kill combo is now named as a build; the mechanic and its boldest cards are unchanged.
